wikibaseboolean-datatype-label: Label shown for the WikibaseBoolean property data type wherever Wikibase lists available data types: the property-creation form, the data type selector, and statement/snak display. Keep this short (it competes for space with other data type names like "String" or "Item").
wikibaseboolean-value-true: Text shown for a PT:boolean value that is true, wherever Wikibase displays statement/snak values (plain text, HTML, and wikitext output). A wiki operator may override this on-wiki (e.g. to "Canon" for a fiction-wiki-specific property) via MediaWiki:Wikibaseboolean-value-true.
wikibaseboolean-value-false: Text shown for a PT:boolean value that is false. See wikibaseboolean-value-true for the sibling message and override mechanism.
